_comment: One unit of competency. It exists as a file because the catalogue lists a unit — and Moodle gets a grade item for it — only once this file ships. The lessons below were READ OFF the built pages' data-criteria, not asserted here, so this cannot drift from what is actually taught.
title: Fasten members with nails, screws and glue

criteria.text: Select a nail for a job from its head and section: wire nail for rough work, oval brad where splitting must be avoided, lost head where the head is to be punched and filled, panel pin for light work with glue.
Apply the rule that two thirds of a fastener's length should enter the lower member, and pre-drill in hardwood or near an end to avoid splitting.
criteria.evidence: Work inspected for splitting; written test.

criteria.text: Select a screw by head type for the job: countersunk flush in woodwork, round head for fittings without countersunk holes, coach screw tightened with a spanner for heavy work.
Apply glue evenly and sparingly so that it does not spill over when the joint is cramped up.
